answer: The zephyr test I would run is Lapidary faceted gem mark witnessed by the crystal register: each faceted gem is a wax seal pressed beside the cutters mark, so a farm must cut a hundred real stones by hand, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the falcon of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the yarrow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
